home.storyPara1: When I started SILKDEV, I was learning business in real time — writing my first professional emails, learning how to price a project, and figuring out how to sell without feeling like I was pretending. Every lesson came the hard way.
home.storyPara2: Four years later, we had a team: people from different countries and backgrounds, each carrying a vision of their own, choosing to build something alongside me. I felt nothing but pride working with them. I'm still indebted to every single one of them. That part doesn't go away.
home.storyPara3: Then AI arrived — and the market didn't just shift. It collapsed overnight. The craft we had spent years sharpening became something a prompt could imitate. Clients who once needed a team now needed a subscription. Developers who had spent a decade building expertise began seeing their roles disappear from the very job posts they used to fill. We watched it happen in real time. And we had a choice: roll over and let it consume us, or place a real bet on a pivot.
home.pivotBody1: So we stopped digging and started building the tools everyone rushing in would need. In a commoditized market, that is the position with leverage.
home.pivotBody2: We stopped taking clients. And we started building.
home.silklearnHeadline: SILKLEARN is knowledge infrastructure that keeps compounding.
home.jobsStory: Steve Jobs spent a semester studying calligraphy at Reed College, dropped out, and had no obvious use for it. Ten years later, that stray semester helped shape why every Mac shipped with proportional spacing and multiple typefaces — and why every personal computer that followed eventually copied it. He didn't apply calligraphy to typography. The two ideas collided inside him and produced something neither contained alone.
home.galileoStory: Galileo watched a chandelier swing in a cathedral in 1583 and saw the laws of pendulum motion. He was there for a church service; the pendulum wasn't the point. But the way he had already structured everything he knew made the collision inevitable.
home.bridgeQuestion: What would a person become if they carried both of those structures? Not Jobs's opinions or Galileo's conclusions, but the shape of how they connected things: the way Jobs moved between aesthetics, function, and urgency; the way Galileo could hold a wrong theory about tides for thirty years while still being right about what mattered.
home.structureInsight: We are not only what we know. We are the order our knowledge arrived in — the contradictions we had to hold, the gaps that forced us to build bridges nobody else needed. That structure is rarely written down. It lives between the lines of every document, inside the assumptions the author knew so well they forgot to explain them.

faq.q: How much does a project cost?
faq.a: Every project is scoped individually. Tell us what you're building and we'll come back with a fixed-price quote — no public price list, no surprises.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: Typical timelines: showcase sites 2–3 weeks, pro sites with blog 3–5 weeks, complex platforms 6–12 weeks. We give you a precise timeline during scoping.

faq.q: Do you redesign existing sites?
faq.a: Yes. We can rebuild your current site with modern tech while preserving your SEO rankings and content. We start with an SEO audit to make sure nothing is lost.

faq.q: What if I already have a design?
faq.a: We can work from your Figma files or design system. We'll audit the design for feasibility and performance before starting development.

faq.q: Do you provide hosting and domains?
faq.a: We set up hosting on Vercel, AWS, or your preferred provider. We can also manage domains, SSL certificates, and email configurations as part of our maintenance package.

faq.q: How do revisions work?
faq.a: Our process includes structured feedback rounds at each milestone — design, development, pre-launch. Minor revisions are included; major scope changes are quoted separately.

faq.q: What happens after launch?
faq.a: We offer a 30-day post-launch warranty covering any bugs or issues. After that, you can opt into our monthly maintenance plan or self-manage with our documentation.

faq.q: Do you build mobile apps too?
faq.a: We focus on web applications. For iOS/Android native apps, we partner with trusted mobile developers and can manage the project end to end.

faq.q: How is this different from hiring a full-time CTO?
faq.a: A fractional CTO costs 70% less than a full-time executive hire and gives you the same strategic value. You pay for the hours you need — no equity, no long-term commitment. Most engagements start at 8–12 hours per week.

faq.q: How many hours per week?
faq.a: Most engagements start at 8–12 hours per week, adjusted based on your stage and complexity. We're flexible — scale up during critical phases and down during steady periods.

faq.q: Do you work with non-technical founders?
faq.a: Absolutely. In fact, that's our sweet spot. We translate between business goals and technical decisions so you can make informed choices without a CS degree.

faq.q: Can you help me hire my own CTO later?
faq.a: Yes. Many clients start with us fractionally while searching for a full-time CTO. We can define the role, vet candidates, and ensure a smooth handoff when you're ready.

faq.q: What if we already have a dev team?
faq.a: Even better. We audit your current processes, identify bottlenecks, and mentor your existing team. No turf wars — we augment, not replace.

faq.q: How do you handle confidential information?
faq.a: We sign NDAs and can accommodate your preferred data security practices. Our engagements are built on trust — we treat your roadmap and metrics as your property.

ai-support-agents.title: AI Support Agents
ai-support-agents.tagline: Your customers, answered in your tone, 24/7.

items: Trained on your docs & brand tone
ai-support-agents.processTitle: How we ship your support agent

processSteps.title: Audit your inbox
processSteps.description: We study your customer messages, common questions, and tone to map what the agent must handle — and what must reach a human.

processSteps.title: Train on your knowledge
processSteps.description: Your docs, policies, and past conversations become the agent's source of truth — grounded answers with citations, no hallucinations.

processSteps.title: Deploy on your channels
processSteps.description: WhatsApp, web chat, or email — the agent goes live on the channels your customers already use.

processSteps.title: Monitor & improve
processSteps.description: We watch resolution rates and handoff quality, and tune the agent weekly. You see the numbers, not a black box.

quote.note: Most clients see their response time drop from hours to seconds within the first two weeks.

faq.q: Will the AI agent sound robotic?
faq.a: No. It's trained on your brand tone and real conversations, and it writes naturally in all three languages.

faq.q: What happens when the agent can't answer?
faq.a: It escalates to your team with full context — the customer never repeats themselves.

faq.q: Which channels can we start with?
faq.a: WhatsApp and web chat are the fastest to launch. Email and Instagram DM follow quickly.

faq.q: Which AI features are worth building?
faq.a: Start with search, tagging, or summarization — they touch the most users and the value is measurable.

faq.q: Can you integrate with our existing stack?
faq.a: Yes — we work inside your codebase and data layer, whatever the stack.

faq.q: What about AI cost?
faq.a: We engineer for cost: the right model for each task, caching, and routing — most features run on pennies per thousand requests.

knowledge-ai.title: Knowledge & Document AI
knowledge-ai.outcome: Your PDFs, Notion, Drive folders, and internal wikis become one searchable knowledge base that your team and customers can ask questions of. Grounded answers with sources — built on the same deterministic engine that powers SILKLEARN.
knowledge-ai.processTitle: How we make your knowledge answerable

processSteps.title: Map your knowledge
processSteps.description: We inventory where your knowledge lives — files, wikis, chat history — and what questions people actually ask it.

processSteps.title: Index with structure
processSteps.description: Documents are decomposed into typed, sourced segments with provenance — not a retrieval blob.

processSteps.title: Deploy the interface
processSteps.description: A chat interface for your team, an FAQ widget for customers, or both — permissions respected.

processSteps.title: Keep it fresh
processSteps.description: Updates re-index automatically; new documents are picked up without you touching a config.

quote.note: Grounding with citations means your team can trust every answer — and verify it in one click.

faq.q: Which sources can you connect?
faq.a: PDFs, Office docs, Notion, Google Drive, websites, and even chat history. If it's accessible, we can index it.

faq.q: How is this different from ChatGPT?
faq.a: Answers are grounded in your documents with citations, permissions are respected, and updates reflect automatically.

faq.q: Is our data safe?
faq.a: Yes — your content stays in your infrastructure or a private index. We never train on your data.

automation.title: Workflow Automation
automation.outcome: The repetitive operations that eat your week — invoicing, lead routing, reporting, CRM hygiene, get automated end to end. Your team stops copy-pasting and starts working on the things only they can do.

processSteps.title: Find the time sinks
processSteps.description: We shadow your operations and map every repetitive task with a cost — minutes per week per person.

processSteps.title: Design the workflows
processSteps.description: Each automation gets a clear trigger, steps, and failure handling. You approve before anything runs.

processSteps.title: Build & connect
processSteps.description: We wire your tools together — CRMs, payments, sheets — with the integrations you already use.

processSteps.title: Run & maintain
processSteps.description: Automations are monitored; we fix breaks and add new ones as your operations evolve.

quote.note: Teams typically reclaim 10+ hours per person per week from the automations we ship.

faq.q: Which processes are worth automating first?
faq.a: Anything done more than once a day that follows a rule — lead routing, invoicing, report prep.

faq.q: Will it work with our current tools?
faq.a: Almost always — we integrate with what you already use before introducing anything new.

faq.q: What if a workflow breaks?
faq.a: Failures are monitored and alerted; we maintain what we build as part of the monthly plan.

faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a:
Every project is scoped individually. Tell us what you're building and we'll come back with a fixed-price quote — no public price list, no surprises.

Here's how to think about the price: you don't want the cheapest parachute, and you don't want the cheapest surgeon — you want the one who does the job right the first time. A cheap site that has to be rebuilt always ends up costing more.

items.q: How long does it take to build a website?
items.a:
Typical timelines depend on the project scope:

  • Showcase site (5 pages): 2–3 weeks
  • Pro site (10 pages + blog): 3–5 weeks
  • Complex platform (e-commerce, custom features): 6–12 weeks

And a note on expectations: a solid build is like muscle — nobody gets it after a week at the gym. Quality takes the time it takes, which is exactly why we give you a precise timeline at scoping instead of a rushed promise.

We'll give you a precise timeline during the project scoping phase.

We specialize in modern web technologies:

  • Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
  • Backend: Node.js, Python, Go
  • CMS: Sanity, custom solutions
  • Animation: Framer Motion, GSAP
  • Hosting: Vercel, AWS, self-managed

We choose the right stack for each project's needs.
Yes — we offer ongoing maintenance, monitoring, and updates tailored to your stack. You can opt into a monthly plan or self-manage with our documentation. Every plan is quoted individually.

Every site we build comes with built-in SEO best practices: semantic HTML structure, optimized meta tags, fast loading speeds (Core Web Vitals), and mobile responsiveness. For more comprehensive SEO strategies — including keyword research, content optimization, and link building — we offer dedicated SEO packages.

Think of it as a three-legged stool: design, development, and SEO. Two legs can look fine for a while, but the stool only stands with all three — which is why we build SEO in from day one.

items.q: Do you work with international clients?
items.a: Absolutely! While we're based in Tunisia, we work with clients worldwide. We communicate in English and French, and our development process is fully remote-friendly. Timezone differences are managed with flexible scheduling and asynchronous communication.
